Interactive query REPL

Ask the Neurosynth database questions in logic, from your browser.

Datalog with probabilities, over the studies, terms and activation peaks of Neurosynth. It runs here, on your machine: nothing to install, nothing sent to a server.

$ neurolang-query -i --engine neurosynth --resolution 2
  • Python on Pyodide
  • Neurosynth v7 · MNI 2 mm
  • about 100 MB the first time, then cached
Good to know
  • Type .help for the commands; results come as tables you can sort, filter and download, and .view opens the brain viewer below.
  • Queries that need gigabytes of memory, such as the whole of the uniformity-test tutorial, may not fit in a browser tab. A query cannot be interrupted: Restart session starts again.
  • The same command runs in a terminal after pip install "neurolang[tui]".
